title: Chen–Cheung's higher-order Wilker inequality conjecture
statement:
For $0<x<\pi/2$ and $n\geq1$, let $B_n$ denote the Bernoulli numbers, and interpret an empty sum as zero.

**Chen–Cheung's higher-order Wilker inequality conjecture.**

$$
\left(\frac{x}{\sin x}\right)^2+\frac{x}{\tan x}<2+\sum_{k=2}^{n}\frac{(k-1)\,2^{2k+1}|B_{2k}|}{(2k)!}x^{2k}+\frac{n\,2^{2n+3}|B_{2(n+1)}|}{(2n+2)!}x^{2n+1}\tan x.
$$

This conjecture generalizes the previously known second Wilker inequality by providing bounds involving arbitrarily many Bernoulli-number terms.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.00436

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2016).
source_name: C. P Chen and R B Paris, “On the Wilker and Huygens-type inequalities”, arXiv:1602.00436 (2016).
